mapper.insert: INSERT INTO external_status_mapping (tenant_id, provider, binding_id, external_issue_type_id, external_status_id, external_status_name, work_type, status_node_id, enabled) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{provider}, #{bindingId}, #{externalIssueTypeId}, #{externalStatusId}, #{externalStatusName}, #{workType}, #{statusNodeId}, #{enabled})
